$comment: Device Life Cycle Management (DLCM) — the stage graph a device walks through, from the
DLCM flow chart. This file is the single source of truth for: which stage a device is in,
which transitions are legal, which of them THIS APP can drive (by emailing a CSV) and which
belong to somebody else (the Installer App, the customer, the order integration).
`stageField` is the Asset field that carries the stage. It is a numeric code, -2..14; the
chart draws -2..12, so 13 and 14 exist in the org but are not modelled here — an unmapped
code is reported as unmapped rather than guessed at.
Anything marked `uncertain` was read off the chart where the arrow's endpoint was ambiguous.
Each one is surfaced in the UI so it can be confirmed and corrected here in one line.

stages.label: Pre-Production
stages.note: Where an initial load lands. The device exists as an Asset but has not been QA'd out to the vendor yet.

stages.label: Shipped From Vendor
stages.note: In transit from the manufacturer. A shipment update put it here.

stages.label: Shipped Active
stages.note: With the customer, sim active, not yet in a vehicle.

stages.label: Shipped Spare
stages.note: With the customer as a spare — shipped with an inactive sim.

stages.label: Installed
stages.note: Fitted in a vehicle. The Installer App puts it here, not this app.

stages.label: RMA Pending
stages.note: Faulty and in warranty. Waiting for the customer to submit the RMA form.

stages.label: RMA Initiated
stages.note: RMA form submitted; the device is on its way back.

stages.label: Returned RMA
stages.note: Back with Netradyne under warranty. From here it is refurbished or marked dead.

stages.label: Non-RMA Pending
stages.note: Out of warranty or contract expired. A return has not been raised yet.

stages.label: NF OOW
stages.note: Not functional, out of warranty. Can be reverted to functional, returned, or killed.

stages.label: Dead
stages.note: End of life. Only Undo mark dead brings it back.

transitions.label: Data Update
transitions.note: Octo requires this data correction step after initial load. Other families may skip it.

transitions.label: Received at 3PL
transitions.uncertain: The chart leaves this arrow unlabelled. Mapped to the Received at 3PL operation because that is the step described as following a shipment update, and DEVICE_RECEIVED_AT_3PL is the matching sync status.

transitions.label: New Order Integration
transitions.note: Skips New entirely — the order integration ships straight to the customer.

transitions.label: Shipped To Customer with Inactive Sim
Device installed in vehicle, triggered from Installer App
Device removed from Vehicle by Customer
Issue with Device, device is in warranty
Issue with Device, device is out of warranty
Revert back to Functional — associated to a placeholder vehicle
Revert back to Functional — associated to a real vehicle
Received by Netradyne
transitions.uncertain: Same as the RMA leg — external until the sheet for it is confirmed.

transitions.label: Refurbish Device
transitions.uncertain: Read off the chart as returning to Shipped From Vendor. No refurbish operation exists in this app, so nothing here depends on it.

transitions.label: Refurbish Device
transitions.uncertain: Same arrow as the RMA leg.

transitions.label: Undo Dead Device
transitions.uncertain: Read off the chart as returning to New. The arrow also grazes Shipped Active; New is the reading that matches the operation's name and the sellable-stock meaning of stage 1.

$comment: Operations that do not move a device between stages, and operations the chart does not
cover. Everything else is derived from `transitions` above — an operation named there
moves the device, and that is what drives the next-step suggestion.

updateLoad.note: Corrects data on a device that is already loaded. Does not move it.

dataUpdate.note: Warranty / data correction. Does not move it.

nonRepairable.note: No arrow on the chart. Likely one of codes 13–14, which the chart does not draw.

faultyReturned.note: No arrow on the chart. Likely one of codes 13–14, which the chart does not draw.

wizardUpload.note: Not emailed and not a stage change — it attaches serials to an order.

$comment: Sync_Status__c base per operation, from the process spec's picklist. Polling appends
_SYNC_SUCCESS / _SYNC_FAILED. An operation absent here cannot be watched converge, and
the UI says so instead of polling for a status that will never appear.
